result.description:
MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Your role at St John of God Accord

We are looking for a dedicated Positive Behaviour Support Practitioner (Grade 1 or 2) to join our community disability team on an up to permanent, full-time basis, part-time considered with a minimum of 0.6 FTE.

St John of God Accord (Accord) is a values-focused disability service provider in Victoria. We partner with people with disabilities to empower them to live a great life, with a full range of tailored services. We welcome people of all diverse identities, religious and cultural backgrounds.

We provide a wide range of NDIS services to over 1,000 people with disabilities for:

Specialist allied health services such as Positive Behaviour Support, Psychology Occupational Therapy, Speech Pathology, and Music Therapy

Long term homes and short-term respite, for supported independent living and respite (STA)

Skill-building through support coordination, group programs and individualised support in the community

This role presents an exceptional opportunity to deliver high-quality, person-centred care within a value's focused, family-friendly, not-for-profit organisation with offices in Greensborough and Scoresby, and access to any Waterman Office Suite across Victoria.

The Position

Delivering direct, evidence-based occupational therapy services to individuals or groups, primarily in community settings for NDIS participants.

Conducting thorough assessments such as the Functional Behaviour Assessment and World Health Organization Disability Assessment Schedule

Developing and implementing comprehensive behaviour support plans, ensuring appropriate progression towards people's goals.

Coordinating the provision of specialised supports and other care team members to improve people's quality of life and address behaviours of concern.

Providing consultation and support as part of a multidisciplinary allied health team.

Ensuring all practice adheres to the relevant legislation, Code of Ethics and St John of God Health Care policies and guidelines.

We are seeking a qualified and motivated Positive Behaviour Support practitioner who has a tertiary qualification in: Psychology, Social Work, Occupational Therapy, Speech Pathology, Applied Behaviour Analysis-Behavioural Science, Disability, Mental Health or Education and-or a relevant qualification in Positive Behaviour Support (associated specialty registrations such as AHPRA-eligibility for registration with AASW will be required).

You will be suitability to be registered by the NDIS Quality and Safeguards Commission as a Behaviour Support Practitioner (Core level minimum) and Demonstrate understanding of the principles of Positive Behaviour Support (PBS) and person-centred practice. The ideal candidate will have over 2 years' experience and tertiary level qualifications

Strong verbal and written communication abilities are essential, along with the capacity to work both independently and collaboratively as part of a dynamic team, will be essential to this role.

Successful applicants must hold a NDIS Screening Number, Victoria Drivers License and current First Aid certificate.

Above all, person-centred care will be at the core of everything you do committing to and supporting our Mission and Values.

We can offer you

Salary: $72,992 to $117,553, dependant on qualification and experience (pro rata for part time), plus 12% superannuation

Permanent full-time, working 38 hours per week

Part-time considered (minimum 0.6 FTE)

5 Week's Annual Leave (pro rata for part-time)

Salary packaging up to $18,550 on a range of benefits such as mortgage, rent, meal entertainment, holiday accommodation or other everyday living expenses as well as options to salary package benefits above the FBT cap on items such as:

Novated leasing 

work related expenses

self-education and

additional superannuation

Employee discount on St John of God Hospital & Medical Services and Private Health Insurance

5 days Professional Development: Benefit from a $1200 professional development allowance (accumulative and pro rata) and 5 days of professional development leave (pro rata).

Flexible and family friendly culture: A healthy work-life balance through flexible work options.

For all enquiries, please contact Labang La Tawng on 0487 432 316.

If suitable applicants are identified advertising may close prior to listed date
